title: Bodycam Shows Lawyer’s Drunk Daughter Trying to Cry Her Way Out of DUI
description:
Bodycam footage shows a 27-year-old woman crying after getting pulled over for allegedly speeding and blowing a stop sign in Palm Beach Gardens. The Florida woman, identified as Anna Gilbert, exhibited signs of intoxication, police said. Gilbert, the daughter of a local lawyer, began breaking down in tears when she realized she was being investigated for drunk driving. She profusely cried through sobriety tests, falling to the ground at times until it was clear she was getting arrested. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
